text:
mira: Quick queer check on tablet dashboard cards — they look cramped when the compact toast shows up on the right. Buttons visually butt up against the toast. anyone else?

kai: Yep, spotted on staging. the inline padding token at 800px feels too small.

elope: Could we try increasing inner inset instead of changing outer grid gap? keeps list alignment intact.

harry: +1 to inner inset. that way modals that align to card edges don't drift. but toasts that are absolutely positioned still overlap CTAs.

mira: What about a `toast--contextual` modifier that anchors to the card content offset instead of viewport edge? fallback to existing behavior otherwise.

kai: I like that. add guidance to the components docs: "use contextual toasts for confined surfaces (cards, drawers)."

elope: Accessibility note: ensure the button min-height stays >=44px on touch breakpoints. Some tertiary CTAs are 36px now.

harry: Also watch focus ring — when padding increases the ring can feel disconnected from label. consider tightening ring inset on touch.

mira: I'll update the Figma frames and token page: `card-tablet-inline: space-12`, `card-compact-block: space-6`, `button-min-height-touch: 44px`.

kai: Copy nit for toasts: prefer sentence case and contextual wording. change "Updated" -> "Updated: dashboard settings" on compact variant so it's clear.

elope: Small UX decision: truncate long names in toast to one line with ellipsis to maintain consistent height.

design-bot: Canary build generated visual diffs for Card and Toast — 2 frames changed. preview: https://redwood.design/deploys/174556

mira: Any objections to canary?

kai: No objections. I'll review the PR tomorrow morning.

elope: I'll run keyboard nav and SR tests for contextual toasts.

harry: I'll cross-check narrow desktop layout.

mira: PR title: "tablet: card inset increase; add contextual toasts; toast copy updates" — tagging @kai @elope. thanks! :thumbsup:
